description: Mark an open incident as being handled so its repeat alerts stop; the recovery alert still goes out when it resolves. Use it when someone is working on the outage. It does not close the incident (that happens when the monitor recovers) and it is not for status page incidents (post_status_page_update). Requires a key with the write scope. Acknowledging twice keeps the first acknowledgement; on a resolved incident it succeeds without effect on alerts. Returns the incident in the get_incident shape.

incident_id.description: The incident's uuid from list_incidents. An id that is not an incident of this organization is a 404.

name: acknowledge_incident

cause.description: Known values: TIMEOUT, DNS_FAILURE, CONNECTION_REFUSED, TLS_INVALID, HTTP_4XX, HTTP_5XX, HTTP_UNEXPECTED_STATUS, KEYWORD_MISSING, TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS, TARGET_BLOCKED, PORT_STATE_MISMATCH, INVALID_TARGET, HEARTBEAT_MISSED, HEARTBEAT_FAILED, UNKNOWN.

channel_type.description: Known values: EMAIL, TELEGRAM, WEBHOOK, SLACK, DISCORD.

title: Acknowledge an incident
